name: puffr
description: Shows Claude Code context usage (via puffr) in the VS Code status bar for the official Claude Code extension.

puffr.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh context usage, in seconds.

puffr.puffrContextPath.description: Path to the puffr-context binary. Default assumes it is on PATH.

puffr.puffrBurnPath.description: Path to the puffr-burn binary. Default assumes it is on PATH.

puffr.showCost.description: Show today's estimated cost for this workspace next to context usage.

puffr.costPollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh cost, in seconds. Cost scans more data than context, so this defaults slower.

puffr.puffrAccountsPath.description: Path to the puffr-accounts binary. Default assumes it is on PATH.

puffr.puffrSessionsPath.description: Path to the puffr-sessions binary. Default assumes it is on PATH.

enumDescriptions: puffr's arcade look (sky, navy, amber), same as the puffr-burn HTML report
Blend in with your VS Code color theme
